stem.text: A cell has an electromotive force (e.m.f.) of $8.0\,\text{V}$ and negligible internal resistance. The cell forms part of a circuit, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with a cell of 8.0 V, two 4.0 Ω resistors in parallel, a resistor labelled R, and two voltmeters labelled V1 and V2.

stem.text: The reading $V_1$ is $4.0\,\text{V}$ and the reading $V_2$ is also $4.0\,\text{V}$.
What is the resistance of resistor R?
